title: Unique least-energy hyperbolic metrics for connected finite weighted graphs surjecting onto the fundamental group of a closed surface of genus greater than one
author: Toru Kajigaya; Ryokichi Tanaka
work: Uniformizing surfaces via discrete harmonic maps
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 4 (2021), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.116
difficulty_reason: The authored argument combines a discrete harmonic-map Hessian along Weil–Petersson geodesics, graph-vertex boundary cancellation and a holomorphic quadratic-differential positivity argument with a collar/Mumford compactness construction and stabilization of markings through surjective fundamental groups. The local new geometric proof is substantially beyond ordinary qualification material.
